---
title: "Graphviz cell options"
# bd-ijlapt70: `//|` cell options on a dot block, with no Q-2-47,
# Q-2-48 or Q-2-57.
#
# - `label` + `fig-cap` build a numbered float, and `fig-align` lands on
#   its `quarto-figure` wrapper (harvested from the diagram, as for an
#   image);
# - a caption without a label builds an unnumbered figure;
# - a bare diagram has no wrapper, so the alignment class lands on the
#   <pre>;
# - `graph-layout` becomes `data-graph-layout`, and `fig-alt` becomes
#   `data-fig-alt`; the init script reads both;
# - the attribute form (`{.dot graph-layout="..."}`) works too;
# - no option line survives into the diagram source.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: "Q-2-4[78]|Q-2-57"
        negate: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div#fig-flow.quarto-figure-right pre.graphviz",
            "div.quarto-figure > figure > pre.graphviz",
            "pre.graphviz.quarto-figure-left",
            "pre.graphviz[data-graph-layout='neato']",
            "pre.graphviz[data-graph-layout='circo']",
            "pre.graphviz[data-fig-alt='Two nodes joined by an edge.']",
          ]
        - ["pre.graphviz[fig-align]", "pre.graphviz[graph-layout]", "pre.graphviz[fig-alt]"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["A numbered float, aligned right\\."]
        - ["//\\| "]
---

See @fig-flow.

```dot
//| label: fig-flow
//| fig-cap: A numbered float, aligned right.
//| fig-align: right
digraph G { a -> b }
```

```dot
//| fig-cap: An unnumbered figure.
digraph G { c -> d }
```

```dot
//| fig-align: left
//| graph-layout: neato
//| fig-alt: Two nodes joined by an edge.
graph G { e -- f }
```

```{.dot graph-layout="circo"}
graph G { g -- h -- i -- g }
```
